title: Airbnb Payout Weekly Days to Payout Trend
dataSources: Airbnb bookings (`airbnb:booking`), Vrbo reservations (`vrbo:reservation`), Airbnb payouts (`airbnb:payout`), and guest reviews (`guest:review`).
app: Airbnb booking exports, Vrbo reservation webhooks, Airbnb payout statements, guest review logs, and turnover checklists streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=airbnb:payout days_to_payout=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(days_to_payout) as avg_duration, max(days_to_payout) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst days to payout for Airbnb payout events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture days_to_payout on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average days to payout with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds whether Airbnb payout tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
